message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Current evaluated points show a clear precision/area tradeoff: the 16-bit LUT gives the best SQNR (82.1 dB) but at the largest LUT area (1584.6 um^2), while 14-bit LUT is much smaller (1346.5 um^2) with still strong SQNR (72.8 dB). The 10-bit LUT is too inaccurate (49.0 dB), so decreasing precision from the current high-precision region is the only legal action with multiple unvisited neighbors and is likely to find a better balance by reducing area while preserving acceptable numerical quality."}
